en: It's probably on the top floor. Let's start by heading there.
(Okay! That takes care of that. Now, I'd better get out of here, too!)
(It's locked.)
You unlocked the door.
Now we gotta split up. I'll leave Baba in your hands, Shinada!
You can count on me! You be careful, Saejima-san!
(This the shrine the villagers were talkin' about?)
(Don't see no sage 'round here.)
Make an offering from the heart, and the mountain gods will share with you their wisdom.
Huh? Who said that?
I know I ain't just hearin' things.
(So I'm supposed to make an offering? Question is, what?)
(The voice said something about mountain gods, so maybe they want something natural from the mountain. I should buy some vegetables from the village.)
(Should I try making an offering?)
It seems the mountain gods do not seek that which you offer.
No good, huh? Guess I'll try something else.
Leave that offering where it is and go. Your gesture will no doubt please the mountain gods.
Yeah? Well, they can have it.
Nothing happened. Guess I got the offering wrong.
Some vegetables from the village might work. Maybe I'll stop by the store.
Very well, I shall grace you with the voices of the heavens.
Hohoho!
Me? I'm the one they call Tendo.
Tendo, huh? Guess I shouldn't be surprised. You definitely got the look of a sage.
A sage? Well, I could see how people might think that.
But truth be told, it is not that simple, for I am a being both animate and inanimate.
Ya lost me already. Whatever, just tell me what you're doin' here.
Well, you see, this shrine is the dwelling of the mountain gods.
These mighty deities are the very creators of this mountain. As for me, I train each day to be able to hear their voices.
You can hear what the gods say? Is that even possible?
The whispering wind, the babbling brook, the creaking tree... They're all murmurings of the gods.
Heed their call and open your mind. Oh, and make an offering to the gods while you're at it.
Uh... An offering?
What did you expect? The gods don't offer their wisdom for nothing.
As you sow, so you shall reap, and all that.
Right. I think I get it.
I imagine it is power you seek. Great strength that will take you to the next level.
Strength? What're you talking about?
No, no, say no more. I know what is in your heart.
I will help you hear the voices of the heavens.
And in so doing, I just might bring myself one step closer to my own enlightenment.
So lemme get this straight. If I make an offering, I can ask you to make me more powerful?
Yes, that's the gist of it. You are quite perceptive, I must say.
And if I ain't sure what to offer, I can ask you?
Just so. Do that, and the mountain gods will surely answer your prayers.
Can't help but feel like you're takin' me for a ride, old man. But what the hell, I'll give it a try.
<Color:7>Heat Actions are not available<Color:Default> in training battles. Make sure you are prepared before you begin, as you never know what might happen on the mountain.
Fine. I'll be back after I get some offerings and stuff.
Excellent. I'll be waiting.
I can't... I can't move! Ngh!
Hold on, old man!
...Old man?
Whoa, he's floatin'!
I am Todoroki, god of this mountain.
Todoroki!?
If it is power you seek, then endure the ordeal I put before you.
Yes, though I can offer no assurance that you shall survive.
But if your heart still beats by the end, new power is what you shall have.
Wait, what're you gonna do?
The time for talk is over! Let us begin!
Is it over?
You okay, old man!?
Every bone in this old body aches. What on earth happened?
You mean you don't remember? You got possessed by some mountain god named Todoroki. Then you said something about an ordeal and attacked me.
Is that what happened? The mountain god Todoroki, you say?
To think a god of the mountain would use my body as a vessel... I'm so happy, I think I'm going to cry.
Hey, cut it out. You're one weird geezer, you know that?
Saejima, was it? I wasn't able to speak with the mountain god, but you did, correct?
You mean Todoroki? Yeah, I did.
Oh... Oh blessed tears of joy...
Will you stop cryin' already and explain what's goin' on?
Do you notice anything different? Did the god of the mountain grant you new power?
Hmm, come to think of it...
You learned <Color:9>Tiger Iron Hammer<Color:Default>.
Hoho! You did gain new power!
I knew these old eyes did not deceive me! This is the happiest day of my life!
Yeah? Well, good for you, old man.
Come again, Saejima. And bring another offering if you are to speak with the gods once more.
Yeah, well this was all kinda creepy, but if it'll make me stronger, I guess it's worth it.
Then I'll look forward to seeing you again.
Here we go again...
Ah, it is you... The one who seeks power.
Is that you, Todoroki?
No, I am his elder brother, Ikazuchi.
Ikazuchi? So Todoroki has a brother?
The clan of the mountain gods watches over this mountain.
There's a whole family of you guys?
Correct. Now then, that you endured Todoroki's ordeal shows you are quite promising for a mortal.
But the ordeal I shall put you through is far more terrible than my brother's.
Never said I'd accept, but it don't look like I got much of a choice.
Enough talk. Now brace yourself, for the trial draws nigh!
You okay, old man?
Did I lose consciousness again?
Yeah. This time, Todoroki's big brother Ikazuchi stopped by.
Todoroki and Ikazuchi... Both gods are told of in the ancient tales of this mountain.
Yeah? Guess I made the acquaintance of a couple of pretty important guys, huh?
That you did. So tell me, what did the gods bestow upon you this time?
Hm, lemme see here...
You learned <Color:9>Tiger Roar<Color:Default>.
Listen to the words of the mountain gods and you just might draw closer to a greater truth.
You are on your way toward achieving a greater connection with the mountain gods⑬one I have only dreamed of. You must continue.
You got it, old man.
Wrong offering?
Guess I hit the mark.
So you are the one who mocks the gods of the mountain?
How many of these guys are there?
I am Homura, first and foremost among the mountain god clan.
Does that make you the dad, then?
That I am. And you have denigrated my sons.
I ain't done nothin' like that.
Your words ring false, for it is the nature of mortals to lie.
If you don't believe a word I say, then I dunno why we're even talkin'.
You claim to seek power. I shall show you what true power is.
Then will you know the folly of your ways!
Gramps? You're not dead, are ya?
Ugh... No, I'm still here.
Ain't this training a little too hard on ya?
You mean being pummeled by an ox of a man like you? The answer is a definitive yes.
Er, yeah... Sorry about that.
No, it's quite all right. Now, tell me what the gods bestowed upon you this time.
Lemme see here...
You learned <Color:9>Tiger Essence of Braining<Color:Default>.
Hmm... I, too, sense something growing within me, albeit slowly.
Something growin' within you? Like what?
I can't say for sure, but I do believe it's a step toward the greater truth.
Well, I don't know much about these mountain gods of yours, but they seem pretty pissed off.
The wrath of the mountain gods is the wrath of nature. A message for us mortals.
You mean like, take better care of the environment? Stuff like that?
Just so. Well, Saejima, I do hope you stop by again.
No, I'm afraid it's merely my backside. It's itching something terrible.
You picked one helluva time to get an itchy ass, old man.
Sorry... Ngh!
Enough already. If it itches that bad, I'll scratch it for ya.
Oh, guess it's the real thing now.
Let us dispense with the pleasantries. Now, prepare yourself!
Whoa, whoa, slow down! Ain't you even gonna tell me your name?
My name? Your ears are not worthy of hearing it.
Heh, this one sounds like a real asshole. The others were at least a little more sociable.
Very well, my name is Seseragi.
So now you gimme your name? What happened to the high and mighty bit?
There is no need for such a tone. You shall find this encounter to your benefit, no doubt.
Now a mountain god's tryin' to calm me down? Man, what next?
If you would seek power, then prove that you can endure my ordeal.
Why didn't ya just open with that instead of wastin' both our time?
There are myriad paths in this world. This is but one of them.
Whatever you say, buddy.
Now, brace yourself!
You there, old man?
Did a mountain god possess me again?
It was some smart-ass named Seseragi this time.
His personality seemed a little erratic, though. These gods are gettin' kinda half-assed.
No, I believe it's simply a matter of each one having a distinct personality in accordance with the natural phenomenon over which it presides.
But enough about that. What sort of power did you gain this time, Saejima?
You learned <Color:9>Herculean Spirit<Color:Default>.
But the offering was a little different this time, and that conversation was... weird.
Can't help thinkin' there's something strange goin' on here.
Don't be silly, Saejima. It's really quite simple. The gods are as fickle as mountain weather.
I dunno about that, but whatever.
Yes, well, I hope you'll visit again when you get a chance.
Yeah, I'll do that.
Well? Did I strike out this time?
Hm...? Ah!
What's goin' on, old man?
Well? What's with that pause?
Let go of the past, and then you shall be free, Saejima.
You know my name? Why'd ya keep callin' me "mortal" before, then?
Oh, right... About your name...
I, uh... I plucked it from the mind of this old man.
Okay, guess that could explain it, considerin' you're possessin' the old guy.
But what gets me is, none of this is surprising me anymore.
I'm Todoroki, leader of the mountain gods.
Todoroki? So you're that first god I met before.
Wait a sec. I thought Homura was supposed to be the boss god.
And you sound different from last time. Not soundin' so, uh... godly this time.
Homura's dead!
What!? Mountain gods can die!?
Just so! And I changed the way I speak so I could become the new leader!
I guess that could explain it, but...
It isn't easy being a mountain god, you know.
Somethin' don't smell right here.
You're actin' kinda weird. If I find out you've been punkin' me...
I can't help feelin' like⑬
Silence! It is time to do battle!
Strange how Todoroki just attacked like that. It was like he was tryin' to hide something.
Ow ow ow!
Don't you know how to pull your punches?
What about those mountain gods? They always come at me like a freight train.
Yes, well, you have a point there.
Anyway, that god was actin' kinda sketchy this time. Kinda hard to believe he was even a god.
Then again, he did say he was Todoroki, so I guess he was the same god I met the first time. Man, now I'm really confused.
That is just the way of the world, Saejima. Some things simply cannot be explained.
Not you, too, old man. I got enough half-assed explanations from Todoroki.
I can't help feelin' there's somethin' fishy with this mountain god thing.
A needless focus on details will only lead to vexation, Saejima.
Now, do you notice any new powers this time?
You learned <Color:9>Tiger Dragon Drop<Color:Default>.
I like powerin' up like this, but something about this whole thing don't sit right with me.
I also noticed the offerings I need to get are startin' to get more expensive.
The gods of the mountains have many needs. You'd be wise to keep showing them your generosity.
Ugh, this is really startin' to bug me. Better get it outta my head or it's gonna keep me up all night.
That would be the wise choice. Clear your mind so you may hear when the gods speak to you.
Well, Saejima, I do hope you stop by again.
This offering's gonna work!?
Who we got this time?
Who is it that disturbs my slumber?
Yaaaah!
Yikes! What the⑬!?
Why did you⑬er, I mean, who is it that disturbs⑬
I knew it! This was all a buncha bull.
Your magic and those mountain gods were total schlock.
What!? Nonsense! Stop this disobedience at once!
You had me goin' for a while, but you blew it when you couldn't keep your gods straight.
Then there's those offerings! I ain't dumb. Anyone could see it's just stuff you yourself wanted.
Fess up, old man. You had a good run, but the cat's outta the bag. You're just lucky I got a good sense of humor.
Apologies. I couldn't stop myself.
Honesty's the best policy. Never forget that.
Why're you doing this anyway? The villagers are really creeped out.
